title: Bound European localized raw banks
platforms: European ROM; retained Wine evidence and protected static census
changes: Bound all five European 71e6f8 physical banks using existing partial owners and independently rooted successor resources.
validation: Protected unit 8cnwq6rl validates five independent 896-byte physical intervals and their existing source hashes, finding 1280 unowned prefix bytes of 4480 total.
limitations: Physical boundaries and source views do not prove exact prefix semantics, ordinary use, other consumers or unrestricted guest indices. Runtime integration, other families and platforms remain open; no performance comparison was made.
